name: Call Log - Agent Summary
query:
SELECT
    cl.employee_user_id AS "Agent:Link/User:180",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Calls:Int:120",
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.type = 'Incoming' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Incoming:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.type = 'Outgoing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Outgoing:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Answered:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'No Answer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Missed:Int:100",
    SEC_TO_TIME(SUM(cl.duration)) AS "Total Talk Time:Data:150"
FROM `tabCall Log` cl
WHERE cl.employee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND cl.employee_user_id != ''
    AND DATE(cl.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY cl.employee_user_id
ORDER BY 2 DESC

name: Call Log - Details
query:
SELECT
    cl.name AS "Call ID:Link/Call Log:120",
    cl.creation AS "Date & Time:Datetime:160",
    cl.type AS "Type:Data:100",
    cl.status AS "Status:Data:110",
    cl.`from` AS "From:Data:180",
    cl.`to` AS "To:Data:180",
    cl.employee_user_id AS "Agent:Link/User:180",
    SEC_TO_TIME(cl.duration) AS "Duration:Data:120"
FROM `tabCall Log` cl
WHERE DATE(cl.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND (%(agent)s = '' OR cl.employee_user_id = %(agent)s)
ORDER BY cl.creation DESC

name: SLA - Priority Summary
query:
SELECT
    t.priority AS "Priority:Link/HD Ticket Priority:120",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Tickets:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Breached:Int:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS "SLA Compliance %%:Percent:120",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.first_response_time)) AS "Avg First Response:Data:150",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.resolution_time)) AS "Avg Resolution Time:Data:150"
FROM `tabHD Ticket` t
WHERE t.docstatus < 2
GROUP BY t.priority
ORDER BY 2 DESC

name: SLA - Ticket Details
query:
SELECT
    t.name AS "Ticket ID:Link/HD Ticket:90",
    t.creation AS "Created On:Datetime:150",
    t.opening_date AS "Opened On:Date:100",
    IFNULL(t.custom_channel, '-') AS "Channel:Data:100",
    t.ticket_type AS "Ticket Type:Link/HD Ticket Type:130",
    t.subject AS "Subject:Data:250",
    t.raised_by AS "Raised By:Data:180",
    t.custom_phone_number AS "Phone Number:Data:130",
    t.custom_agency AS "Agency:Link/Sabre Agency:180",
    t.custom_contact_name AS "Contact Name:Data:150",
    t.custom_agency_pcc AS "PCC:Data:90",
    t.custom_agency_iata AS "IATA:Data:100",
    t.custom_subissue AS "Sub-Issue:Data:180",
    t.agent_group AS "Team:Link/HD Team:150",
    IFNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t._assign, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ''), 'Unassigned') AS "Assigned To:Data:200",
    t.priority AS "Priority:Link/HD Ticket Priority:100",
    t.status AS "Status:Link/HD Ticket Status:100",
    ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.creation,
        IF(t.status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed'), IFNULL(t.resolution_date, t.modified), NOW())) / 1440, 1) AS "Age (Days):Float:100",
    t.response_by AS "Response Due:Datetime:150",
    t.first_responded_on AS "First Responded On:Datetime:150",
    t.first_response_time AS "First Response Time:Duration:150",
    t.first_response_failed_by AS "Response Overdue By:Duration:150",
    CASE
        WHEN t.first_responded_on IS NOT NULL THEN IF(t.first_responded_on <= t.response_by, 'Met', 'Breached')
        WHEN t.response_by IS NULL THEN '-'
        WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Paused' THEN 'Paused'
        WHEN NOW() > t.response_by THEN 'Breached'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Response SLA:Data:110",
    t.resolution_by AS "Resolution Due:Datetime:150",
    t.resolution_date AS "Resolved On:Datetime:150",
    t.resolution_time AS "Resolution Time:Duration:150",
    t.resolution_failed_by AS "Resolution Overdue By:Duration:150",
    CASE
        WHEN t.resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN IF(t.resolution_date <= t.resolution_by, 'Met', 'Breached')
        WHEN t.resolution_by IS NULL THEN '-'
        WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Paused' THEN 'Paused'
        WHEN NOW() > t.resolution_by THEN 'Breached'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Resolution SLA:Data:110",
    IFNULL(t.agreement_status, '-') AS "SLA Status:Data:120",
    NULLIF(t.feedback_rating, 0) AS "Feedback Rating:Rating:120",
    t.feedback AS "Feedback Option:Link/HD Ticket Feedback Option:200",
    t.feedback_extra AS "Feedback Comments:Long Text:250"
FROM `tabHD Ticket` t
WHERE t.docstatus < 2
    AND t.opening_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND (%(status)s = '' OR t.status = %(status)s)
    AND (%(agent_group)s = '' OR t.agent_group = %(agent_group)s)
    AND (%(custom_agency)s = '' OR t.custom_agency = %(custom_agency)s)
    AND (%(channel)s = '' OR t.custom_channel = %(channel)s)
    AND (%(sla_status)s = '' OR t.agreement_status = %(sla_status)s)
    AND (%(assigned_to)s = '' OR t._assign LIKE CONCAT('%%', %(assigned_to)s, '%%'))
ORDER BY t.opening_date DESC, t.creation DESC

name: SLA - Team Summary
query:
SELECT
    t.agent_group AS "Team:Link/HD Team:150",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Tickets:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Breached:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fulfilled:Int:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS "SLA Compliance %%:Percent:120",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.first_response_time)) AS "Avg First Response:Data:150",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.resolution_time)) AS "Avg Resolution Time:Data:150"
FROM `tabHD Ticket` t
WHERE t.docstatus < 2
GROUP BY t.agent_group
ORDER BY 2 DESC

name: SLA - Agent Summary
query:
SELECT
    todo.allocated_to AS "Agent:Link/User:150",
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.name) AS "Total Tickets:Int:100",
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Breached:Int:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.agreement_status = 'Fulfilled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.name) * 100, 1) AS "SLA Compliance %%:Percent:120",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.first_response_time)) AS "Avg First Response:Data:150",
    SEC_TO_TIME(AVG(t.resolution_time)) AS "Avg Resolution Time:Data:150"
FROM `tabHD Ticket` t
JOIN `tabToDo` todo
    ON todo.reference_type = 'HD Ticket'
    AND todo.reference_name = t.name
    AND todo.status != 'Cancelled'
WHERE t.docstatus < 2
GROUP BY todo.allocated_to
ORDER BY 2 DESC
